name: plugin
summary: Build the JUCE 8 plugin (VST3/AU/Standalone, WebView editor embedding web/dist), run pluginval (strictness 5), and load the built VST3 headlessly like a DAW: golden fixtures must hash exactly like the native engine and the editor must build the stage from the patch. `package` makes the notarised universal macOS installer (BlokDust-<version>-Mac.pkg). `ios build|test` builds the iPadOS AUv3 inside the BlokDust app for the Simulator and loads it out of process like AUM: golden hashes ≡ native, state round-trip, editor bd_ready (CHG-0025).
